editorial.blurb: Authentic Puerto Rican flavors shine at this neighborhood favorite, where signature jibaritos and mofongo keep locals and newcomers alike coming back for more.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Jibarito de Lechon or Jibarito de Bistek—they come with Puerto Rican rice and are worth the wait; call ahead or use DoorDash/UberEats if you can't find their full menu online.
